question: How do I fix a large hole in my drywall? The hole is about the size of a grapefruit and is near a corner.
answer: To fix a large hole in your drywall, start by marking the area around the hole with a pencil to define the repair zone. Next, cut a drywall patch slightly larger than the hole using a drywall saw. Apply joint compound to the back of the patch and press it firmly into place. Apply additional joint compound to the edges of the patch and smooth it out. Allow the compound to dry completely before sanding it down using a drywall sanding block. To ensure a tight seal, press the patch firmly into place and then use a putty knife to apply even pressure. Finally, for a seamless repair, use a drywall sanding block to smooth out the edges.
